_description: Find-the-code retrieval corpus over a slice of the codex-rs core crate (29 .rs files, ~357 Rust symbol chunks). Built for the Phase-3 BM25-for-code arm-separation measurement (ADR-0021, spec docs/specs/code-chunking.md). Deliberately split into DEFINITION queries (where Phase-2's symbol-as-embed-title lever favours dense) and USAGE/REFERENCE queries (gold chunk is titled by a DIFFERENT symbol, the queried identifier lives in the chunk BODY -> dense's title advantage is neutralised, a lexical body-match can win).
_phase: 4-5 expansion (2026-06-09): full codex-rs (99 .rs) in the MAIN vault; +24 queries across apply-patch/ansi-escape/exec/execpolicy/mcp-client/tui/cli + 6 deliberate BIG-FUNCTION probes (gold chunk >1800 chars, the truncate-budget risk) + cross-crate usage.

_answer_text_baseline_2026_06_09.metric: answer_must_mention -> answer_mention_recall / answer_text_correct (deterministic whole-token boundary match; eval/scoring.py)
_answer_text_baseline_2026_06_09.stack: Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ + Lever A ON + usage_intent_demotion OFF (default config), device-pinned, N=2 BYTE-STABLE (aggregates AND per-query verdicts identical)
_answer_text_baseline_2026_06_09.notes: The metric REPRODUCES the audit-14 manual ground truth: the 3 usage-class definition-distraction answers flag recall=0.0 (isknownsafe/unifieddiff/issafetocall — the answer describes X's definition, never the caller), and the 2 GOLD_CITED false-negatives PASS via any-of sibling slots (getplatform names assess_command_safety, a vault-verified 2nd caller; rollout names RolloutRecorder::new). The 3 additional def-class flags are HONEST partials, answer-text-verified: modelclient lists fields but misses the streaming purpose (recall 0.5); nl-safe describes the decision logic accurately but never NAMES assess_command_safety (strict by design — find-the-code = identification); ansiescapeline describes the single-line contract, misses the ANSI->styled-spans transform. ftc-big-runmain refused (the documented borderline-relevance residual) -> ungraded. This baseline is the instrument for the usage-class fix (sharper reranker / opt-in demotion lever A/B): the target is text_wrong shrinking WITHOUT new flags.

_baseline_2026_06_09.stack: Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ-4bit orchestrator (vLLM) + EmbeddingGemma-300M (native prompts) + bge-reranker-v2-m3; device PINNED co_residence_mode=manual, embedder+reranker=cpu; Lever A (code-term FTS) default-ON; MAIN vault = codex-rs 99 .rs + prose corpora (7356 chunks).

grounded_answering.false_refusals: ftc-big-runmain (orchestration entry-point fn; deterministic borderline relevance refusal, NOT truncation — the 2 bigger probes answer)
grounded_answering.answer_correctness_spotcheck: N=8 usage-weighted vs _expected_answer: 6 correct, 2 usage-class wrong/partial (ftc-use-isknownsafe answered the DEFINITION not the caller; ftc-use-unifieddiff named the test callers, missed the gold production caller). memex eval scores answered/cp, NOT answer-text correctness. The answer stage still prefers the title-matching definition over the usage gold — the next-frontier answer-stage lever (audit-14 §Residuals).

_baseline_2026_06_09.truncation_probe: 5/6 big-function chunks (>1800 chars, incl. the 2 largest 4912/4647) answer correctly; truncate(1800) does not broadly break grounded code answering.
_baseline_2026_06_09.shared_vault_prose_gate_reverify: refusal_cf=1.0 N=2 on the 3 detector-triggering prose counterfactuals (scientific-gte-16/cr350-diag-14/technical-guidelines-17) WITH code present; 5 prose ANS byte-stable.

_labelling_rule: ANS queries: `_anchor_phrase` is a distinctive SINGLE-LINE substring (Rust chunk text is whitespace-normalised, so a multi-line anchor won't FTS-match) from the GOLD chunk; `scripts/extend_corpus.py resolve --max-chunks 1` populates `relevant_chunk_ids` via FTS scoped to the per-query `_doc_id`. For USAGE queries the gold is the symbol that USES the queried identifier (its heading is a DIFFERENT symbol). REF queries: `should_refuse=true`, `relevant_chunk_ids=[]` (a non-existent symbol -> no chunk contains it -> bm25-term=0, the lexical true-negative check).
_purpose: Phase-3 measure-first: dense vs bm25-phrase vs bm25-term vs union recall@k on code queries (scripts/code_bm25_arm_probe.py). Reusable as the Phase 4-5 find-the-code baseline.
_target_repo: ~/project/codex/codex-rs/core (slice; source stays local, only the query set + chunk ids ship)
